name: Kiriwar
source:
"Think I might smell something. Yeah... the smell of blood."

One of the Executioners, the brutal warriors who enforce the rules of Igra. Wields an iron pipe, and is never seen without a lazy smile on his face.

[From the digital manual included with r57701]
